treatment_df = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']

print(f'Male response rate (treatment arm): {response_rates_treatment["M"]}')
print(f'Difference: {response_rates_treatment["F"] - response_rates_treatment["M"]}')

# Also print the difference as percentage points
response_diff_pct = (response_rates_treatment["F"] - response_rates_treatment["M"]) * 100
